milestone: M14: Custom CSV SFS / RFECV / LassoCV
repository: AIOT-HW2 (historical verification checkout; absolute path redacted)

scope.forward_sfs: Forward Sequential Feature Selection with user-selected integer k; measured fixed-k comparison curve and formal training.
scope.rfecv: Automatically selects integer k independently within each outer Training fold and full Training; comparison is a separate summary and fold table, not a fabricated k curve.
scope.lasso_cv: Selects alpha by inner CV mean MSE over a fixed nine-value grid, refits Lasso on current Training to select nonzero coefficients, then fits a separate LinearRegression.
scope.preprocessing: Explicit standard scaling required. Inner-fold preprocessing fitted on inner Training only. Random KFold or chronological TimeSeriesSplit follows the selected split policy and gap.
scope.zero_selected_features: Comparison records real k=0 and null scores. Formal training fails clearly without a fallback model or fabricated score.
scope.holdout: Held out from preprocessing, selector fitting, alpha selection and model fitting.
scope.existing_controls: Prior k explanation and clickable show/hide Holdout legends retained.

browser.fixture: Synthetic numeric CSVs only; these scores do not represent Boston Housing or energy research results.
browser.all_three_methods: Each compared, applied, explicitly trained, used for single/batch predictions, downloaded and deleted its temporary test model.
browser.auto_only: k range disabled; request k_values is empty; separate automatic method tables shown.
browser.lasso_zero_fixture: All five outer folds selected zero; comparison shows no scores; formal training fails without a prediction form.
browser.original_server: localhost:3000 loads all six methods and successfully trained RFECV; original dev server preserved.
browser.responsive: Desktop light/dark and mobile 390px inspected; no page-level horizontal overflow.
browser.taskspace: Finished and cleaned up; user browser tabs preserved.

download_verification.comparison_json: Fixed and automatic results match actual worker output.
download_verification.comparison_csv: 90 data rows; automatic fold k/features/scores checked against actual worker output.
download_verification.formal_evaluation_json: All three methods match their own worker selection/CV/Holdout results; temporary model IDs excluded.
download_verification.formal_metrics_csv: All three methods include actual final and per-fold selected k.
download_verification.batch_csv: Two actual predictions per method match the corresponding inference response.

manual_acceptance: Refresh http://127.0.0.1:3000/custom-dataset and upload a numeric CSV.
Choose target and candidate columns, choose standard scaling, and validate the dataset.
In comparison check Forward SFS, RFECV and LassoCV; use a small k range for SFS and run comparison.
Inspect the SFS fixed-k curve and the separate RFECV/LassoCV fold tables, selected features, integer k and Lasso alpha.
Apply a method. SFS accepts k; automatic methods hide k. Explicitly confirm and train.
Inspect final and fold metrics/features; try single and batch predictions and download their results.
Inspect in light/dark mode and a narrow viewport; existing Holdout legends toggle series.
